RawInputMouse.description: Use raw relative mouse movement while retaining the game’s buttons, wheel and sensitivity.
plugin.name: Total Overdose Fusion Fix
ResX.description: Override rendering width. If either dimension is zero, use the desktop resolution. Requires a restart.
ResY.description: Override rendering height. If either dimension is zero, use the desktop resolution. Requires a restart.
SkipIntro.description: Skips the SCi and Deadline logos. The story intro and title screen still play. Requires a restart.
FMVWidescreenMode.description: Original shows the videos as the game does, in its 4:3 frame. Fill shows them as large as the screen allows. Both keep each video's own shape and show the whole picture. Applies immediately.
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a window at the chosen resolution, or borderless: a window covering the whole monitor at its resolution. Restart required.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the corrected field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values widen the view. Applies as the game updates its view.
FPSLimit.description: Limits the frame rate. The game is made for 60; higher frame rates can upset its physics and timing. Applies immediately.
PauseOnFocusLoss.description: In a window mode, the game pauses and goes silent while another window is active. Off keeps it running. Applies immediately.
ConfineCursor.description: Keeps the mouse cursor inside the game window while the game is active, so it can't slip onto another monitor. Applies immediately.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto keeps the HUD at the screen edges. A ratio keeps it in a centred box of that shape.
CheckForUpdates.description: Once per start, asks fusionfix.io whether a newer version of the fix is out and shows it in place of the version number in the main menu. Off makes no network request.
